summary: Structured Obligations Corporation Select Notes Trust LT 2003-2 filed a routine Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 reporting an ordinary distribution to holders of its Long Term Certificates Series 2003-2 (CUSIP 81619PAB3) for the September 15, 2026 distribution date. The trustee, U.S. Bank Trust Company, National Association, reported $396,000.00 of interest received during the interest period beginning after August 15, 2026. No special-situation event, board recommendation, advisor, stake, price, premium, or structural change is present; this is a standard periodic ABS distribution notice, with no risk-arb angle beyond routine collateral performance monitoring.
